name: CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel with concurrent radiotherapy, neoadjuvant (CROSS)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Esophageal and Esophagogastric Junction Cancers
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The CROSS chemoradiation backbone (carboplatin plus paclitaxel with radiotherapy) is not biomarker-restricted and applies to both squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma of the esophagus or GEJ. HER2, PD-L1, and MMR or MSI may be tested to plan post-resection or later-line therapy but do not gate this neoadjuvant regimen. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Esophageal and Esophagogastric Junction Cancers v3.2026.

stage: locally advanced, resectable (node-positive or T2 or higher)
histology: squamous cell carcinoma or adenocarcinoma (both eligible)

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling.

supportiveCare: Concurrent radiotherapy: 41.4 Gy in 23 fractions (1.8 Gy daily), given with the 5 weekly chemotherapy doses, followed by transthoracic or transhiatal esophagectomy (DeVita 12th ed., lines 97087 to 97089).
Antiemetics: carboplatin plus paclitaxel weekly; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Esophagitis and nutrition support during concurrent chemoradiation.
monitoring: swallowing / nutritional status and radiation esophagitis

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 or higher hematologic toxicity during chemoradiation
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or reduce the weekly chemotherapy per hematologic recovery; radiotherapy continuation per radiation oncology. Physician decides.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., lines 97081 to 97083. CARBOplatin target AUC 2 mg/mL/minute IV once weekly for 5 weeks, concurrent with radiotherapy. Tall-man per ISMP. dosePerUnit is the target AUC, not mg/m2.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: lines 97081 to 97083 (CROSS: carboplatin at an area under the curve of 2 mg/mL/minute once weekly for 5 weeks)

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., lines 97082 to 97083. PACLitaxel 50 mg/m2 IV once weekly for 5 weeks, concurrent with radiotherapy. Tall-man per ISMP. Standard paclitaxel premedication (corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine).

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: lines 97082 to 97083 (CROSS: paclitaxel 50 mg/m2 once weekly for 5 weeks)
